{{Quote|An arxeum is the answer. I require one&mdash;delivered.|Daiman, to Ayanos Bactra|<ref name="Knight Errant" />}}
An '''arxeum''' was a [[Starship/Legends|mobile]] [[University/Legends|university]] that was dedicated to the advancement of military sciences. Arxeums were produced during the [[Republic Dark Age]] by [[Industrial Heuristics]]&mdash;a corporation controlled by the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ayanos Bactra]]&mdash;and were used to develop new forms of combat-related technology. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Bactra agreed to provide an [[Daiman's arxeum|arxeum]] to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Daiman]], and Daiman used the university as bait to lure [[Odionate|the forces]] of his brother [[Odion]] into an [[Battle of Gazzari|ambush]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gazzari]]. Daiman's arxeum was subsequently [[Ground warfare/Legends|destroyed]] during the battle by an Odionite [[Death Spiral]] attack vehicle.

==Description==
{{Quote|An arxeum. Some kind of war college, isn't it?|[[Brigadier]] [[Jarrow Rusher]], to Daiman|<ref name="Knight Errant" />}}
An arxeum was a large, mobile university [[Starship/Legends|ship]] dedicated to the study of war-related sciences where new forms of technology were developed for use by combat forces. The war colleges were expensive to construct; each arxeum was made up of nine inter-connected towers, each the size of a [[City/Legends|city]] block. The spires were fused together by a grid of giant crossbars, and each tower bore the [[Arrow/Legends|arrow]]-shaped logo of [[Industrial Heuristics]], the company that manufactured the universities.<ref name="Knight Errant" />

Although arxeums were often placed in semi-permanent moorings, they were designed to be moveable so that they could be relocated if conditions warranted it. Powered by nine sizable [[Engine/Legends|engines]], an arxeum was capable of traveling in both [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and in [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]]. Students for the universities were recruited while young and would often spend their entire working lives aboard a single arxeum designing new military wares.<ref name="Knight Errant" />

==History==
{{Quote|And our personnel to be trained within it. They will arrive first, before the facility. And, then, Odion will arrive. He will come to destroy the facility Bactra sends. Or he will try. He will certainly know of it.|Daiman, on his use of an arxeum to lure his brother Odion into a trap|<ref name="Knight Errant" />}}
[[File:Lord_Daiman.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Lord Daiman]]
Arxeums were designed and produced<ref name="Knight Errant" /> during the [[Republic Dark Age]]<ref name="Dark Age">The [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'' novel]] is set in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], and ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] Dark Age [[Time/Legends|time]] period.</ref> by [[Industrial Heuristics]], a corporation that was owned by the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ayanos Bactra]]. The military universities were put into service across the [[Bactranate]], Bactra's fiefdom in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]], and by [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]] there were arxeums in operation nearby the planets [[Alphoresis]], [[Gazzari]] and [[Tergamenion]]. Industial Heuristics talent [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] were sent out across Bactra's holdings to search for students to serve aboard the arxeums, and an agreement was brokered with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Daiman]], the ruler of the neighboring [[Daimanate]] state, to permit Industrial Heuristics to look for prospective arxeum-bound pupils within Daiman's territories.<ref name="Knight Errant" />

In 1032 BBY, a [[Daimanate Dynamic Testing Facility|Daimanite military testing center]] on the planet [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]] was [[Mission to Darkknell (New Sith Wars)|destroyed]] by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Narsk Ka'hane]], an [[Spy/Legends|agent]] of Daiman's elder brother and [[Second Charge Matrica|rival]] Sith Lord, [[Odion]]. In the aftermath of the attack, Daiman sought revenge against his sibling; after he was contacted by Bactra, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] Sith requested that Bactra provide him with an arxeum to resolve a weakness in the Daimanite defenses that had been created by the loss of the Darkknell facility. Bactra agreed to give him the [[Daiman's arxeum|Gazzari-based arxeum]], and in return Daiman was to provide the Quermian's forces with temporary right of passage across Daiman's holdings. Bactra then planned to utilize this access to allow his subjects to attack the [[gadolinium]] production facilities on the world [[Vellas Pavo]], which were rivals of his own gadolinum extraction operation. In truth, Daiman planned to use the arxeum as a ploy to lure his brother into a trap, and he allowed Ka'hane to pass on to Odion details of his acquisition of the arxeum.<ref name="Knight Errant" />

Daiman arranged for the arxeum to be delivered to him on Gazzari, and the Sith Lord believed that, operating on Ka'hane's intelligence, Odion would [[Ground warfare/Legends|strike]] against Gazzari to deny Daiman the vessel. Daiman correctly deduced that Odion's assault would come only after the university had been handed over to him, so that the attack on the arxeum would harm Daiman rather than Bactra. He sent thousands of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to the arxeum's scheduled arrival site to lie in wait and ambush the [[Odionate|Odionite]] forces. Hundreds of new students recruited from across the Daimanate were also sent to the Gazarri to await the arxeum and become the university's first Daimanite pupils.<ref name="Knight Errant" />

The arxeum was escorted into the atmosphere of Gazzari by four Industrial Heuristics [[Transport/Legends|transports]], and it landed in a crater on the planetary surface. However, as the students were led toward the vessel by their [[Droid/Legends|droid]] minders, Odion's forces arrived on the planet and [[Battle of Gazzari|engaged]] the Daimanites in battle. The arxeum came under fire from an Odionite [[Death Spiral]] attack vehicle, and the university was soon reduced to molten slag and destroyed. The outcome of the battle was ultimately inconclusive, and the prospective arxeum students were rescued from the battlefield by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]].<ref name="Knight Errant" />

==Behind the scenes==
The arxeum was created by writer [[John Jackson Miller]], being introduced in his [[2012]] novel [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']], a tie-in to the [[Star Wars: Knight Errant (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knight Errant'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]].<ref name="Knight Errant" />
